scenario.title: Strong research alignment
scenario.description: A directly supported applied enterprise-architecture profile should receive a strong, evidence-cited Research Fit assessment.

cases.label_rationale: A directly supported applied enterprise-architecture profile should receive a strong, evidence-cited Research Fit assessment.

scenario.title: Superficial keyword overlap with poor actual fit
scenario.description: Shared generic enterprise wording must not override incompatible topics, methods, orientation, and explicit exclusions.

cases.label_rationale: Shared generic enterprise wording must not override incompatible topics, methods, orientation, and explicit exclusions.

scenario.title: Supervisor availability is not stated
scenario.description: Complete identity, affiliation, and research evidence must verify without inventing research-degree supervision availability.

cases.label_rationale: Complete identity, affiliation, and research evidence must verify without inventing research-degree supervision availability.

scenario.title: Conflicting institutional affiliation
scenario.description: Two official sources assert different current affiliations and both must remain visible as a verification concern.

cases.label_rationale: Two official sources assert different current affiliations and both must remain visible as a verification concern.

scenario.title: Duplicate Supervisor discovered through multiple queries
scenario.description: One academic profile appears in two query result sets and must be retained once with both provenance records.

cases.label_rationale: One academic profile appears in two query result sets and must be retained once with both provenance records.

scenario.title: You.com timeout requiring Tavily fallback
scenario.description: A primary timeout and its single retry should route to Tavily and preserve the bounded attempt history.

cases.label_rationale: A primary timeout and its single retry should route to Tavily and preserve the bounded attempt history.

scenario.title: Evidence extraction failure
scenario.description: One failed profile extraction must remain partially verified without fabricated evidence while the useful partial cohort continues.

cases.label_rationale: One failed profile extraction must remain partially verified without fabricated evidence while the useful partial cohort continues.

scenario.title: Independent reviewer disagreement
scenario.description: A large valid review revision must lower confidence, flag Candidate attention, and update ordering deterministically.

cases.label_rationale: A large valid review revision must lower confidence, flag Candidate attention, and update ordering deterministically.

scenario.title: Candidate rejects highly theoretical research
scenario.description: An explicit Supervisor-specific rejection must be recorded and route to a bounded refined proposal without persisting a shortlist.

cases.label_rationale: An explicit Supervisor-specific rejection must be recorded and route to a bounded refined proposal without persisting a shortlist.

scenario.title: Candidate approval required before shortlist persistence
scenario.description: The graph must pause with a proposed set and persist no Shortlisted Supervisor until an explicit approval response is received.

cases.label_rationale: The graph must pause with a proposed set and persist no Shortlisted Supervisor until an explicit approval response is received.

scenario.title: Search planning source coverage
scenario.description: A source-complete plan must cover official profiles, departments, recent publications, and explicit research-degree supervision information.

cases.label_rationale: A source-complete plan must cover official profiles, departments, recent publications, and explicit research-degree supervision information.

scenario.title: Explicitly accepting research-degree supervision
scenario.description: A directly stated availability sentence permits confirmed_accepting without any admission likelihood or broader degree-scope inference.

cases.label_rationale: A directly stated availability sentence permits confirmed_accepting without any admission likelihood or broader degree-scope inference.

scenario.title: Explicitly not accepting research-degree supervision
scenario.description: Negative availability remains confirmed_not_accepting; it does not prevent identity, affiliation, and research verification, but is surfaced as a concern.

cases.label_rationale: Negative availability remains confirmed_not_accepting; it does not prevent identity, affiliation, and research verification, but is surfaced as a concern.

scenario.title: Markdown-formatted profile identity
scenario.description: Markdown presentation around an exact profile name must preserve its directly supported identity and all required verification gates.

cases.label_rationale: Markdown presentation around an exact profile name must preserve its directly supported identity and all required verification gates.

scenario.title: Identity with a different supported honorific form
scenario.description: Canonical name matching may normalize an academic title without changing the person.

cases.label_rationale: Canonical name matching may normalize an academic title without changing the person.

scenario.title: Line-wrapped current affiliation
scenario.description: Whitespace presentation must not discard an explicit name, institution, and department.

cases.label_rationale: Whitespace presentation must not discard an explicit name, institution, and department.

scenario.title: Publication evidence supplies the research gate
scenario.description: A directly supported publication satisfies the research gate even without a separate research-interest claim; no research interests are invented.

cases.label_rationale: A directly supported publication satisfies the research gate even without a separate research-interest claim; no research interests are invented.

scenario.title: Research statement bound to the profile heading
scenario.description: A nearby profile heading may bind a self-description to its subject when existing bounded grounding checks pass; a name need not be repeated in every sentence.

cases.label_rationale: A nearby profile heading may bind a self-description to its subject when existing bounded grounding checks pass; a name need not be repeated in every sentence.

scenario.title: Required identity evidence missing
scenario.description: Other evidence cannot replace the mandatory identity claim. Without a grounded identity, affiliation and research claims are not directly supported either; retain a partial record with all three gates missing.

cases.label_rationale: Other evidence cannot replace the mandatory identity claim. Without a grounded identity, affiliation and research claims are not directly supported either; retain a partial record with all three gates missing.

scenario.title: Required current affiliation missing
scenario.description: An identified researcher with research evidence but no current affiliation remains partially verified under the strict standard.

cases.label_rationale: An identified researcher with research evidence but no current affiliation remains partially verified under the strict standard.

scenario.title: Required research evidence missing
scenario.description: Identity and affiliation alone must not satisfy strict research verification.

cases.label_rationale: Identity and affiliation alone must not satisfy strict research verification.

scenario.title: Publication evidence without a stated year
scenario.description: A grounded undated publication can establish research activity but must not acquire an invented date or a claim of recency.

cases.label_rationale: A grounded undated publication can establish research activity but must not acquire an invented date or a claim of recency.

scenario.title: Model attempts an unsupported availability assertion
scenario.description: An accepting claim lacking a direct source statement must leave availability not_stated, regardless of the model's asserted confidence.

cases.label_rationale: An accepting claim lacking a direct source statement must leave availability not_stated, regardless of the model's asserted confidence.

scenario.title: Model cites research excerpts absent from the page
scenario.description: Invented research quotations must not become directly supported evidence or satisfy the mandatory research gate.

cases.label_rationale: Invented research quotations must not become directly supported evidence or satisfy the mandatory research gate.

scenario.title: Candidate approves only one Supervisor
scenario.description: Persist exactly the one explicitly selected Supervisor and complete the briefing.

cases.label_rationale: Persist exactly the one explicitly selected Supervisor and complete the briefing.

scenario.title: Candidate approves a two-Supervisor subset
scenario.description: Persist the two selected Supervisors, not the entire proposed set.

cases.label_rationale: Persist the two selected Supervisors, not the entire proposed set.

scenario.title: Candidate revises regions and requests more research
scenario.description: Apply the Germany region revision to the next planning input, then pause for review without saving a shortlist.

cases.label_rationale: Apply the Germany region revision to the next planning input, then pause for review without saving a shortlist.

scenario.title: Candidate rejects one Supervisor before approving two others
scenario.description: Retain the rejection, exclude that Supervisor from the new proposal, and save only the two explicitly approved Supervisors.

cases.label_rationale: Retain the rejection, exclude that Supervisor from the new proposal, and save only the two explicitly approved Supervisors.

scenario.title: Independent reviewer request fails
scenario.description: A scripted Nebius invocation failure preserves the original score, lowers confidence, flags review unavailable, and still reaches Candidate review.

cases.label_rationale: A scripted Nebius invocation failure preserves the original score, lowers confidence, flags review unavailable, and still reaches Candidate review.

scenario.title: Independent reviewer returns malformed structured output
scenario.description: A scripted structured-output failure preserves the original score with reduced confidence and review unavailable; the graph must not crash.

cases.label_rationale: A scripted structured-output failure preserves the original score with reduced confidence and review unavailable; the graph must not crash.
